content.short: TokenTag unifies social channels and chains to create a concise Web3 social ecosystem.
content.description: TokenTag integrates Discord, Twitter, and on-chain data with native content to surface what matters most: community and friends' activity. It offers a single, customizable, searchable home page for communities, helping members stay informed and communicate securely while exploring Web3. The platform also supports creators and streamlines community building. Its community dashboard and analytics provide data-driven insights into a creator's audience, while filtering and group tools let managers gauge member contribution and brand dedication across Web3, fueling growth through integrated engagement, rewards channels, and automations.
